findings.title: Dopamine & Motivation
findings.summary: Dopamine is the primary determinant of motivation, excitement, and willingness to pursue goals. Higher dopamine = feeling good, lower = feeling unmotivated.
findings.application: Expanse's reward system triggers dopamine through anticipation and achievement of rewards

findings.title: Approach Motivation
findings.summary: Dopamine increases in anticipation of reward, improving mood. After receiving reward, dopamine decreases, motivating pursuit of more.
findings.application: Loot boxes, progress bars, and achievement unlocks leverage this cycle

findings.title: Operant Conditioning
findings.summary: Animals trained by reward methods look forward to training because it's a way to earn treats. Same applies to students and academic tasks.
findings.application: Positive reinforcement through immediate rewards for task completion

findings.title: Learning & Attention
findings.summary: Learning and memory are direct consequences of attention - the more attention devoted to something, the more likely it will be learned and remembered.
findings.application: Gamification increases attention and engagement, improving learning outcomes

findings.title: Social Validation in Puberty
findings.summary: Children beginning puberty are socially insecure, easily swayed by peer pressure, and attracted to activities offering social validation.
findings.application: Social recognition features, achievements, and sharing capabilities

findings.title: Engagement Decline with Age
findings.summary: Only one-third of students are engaged. 74% of 5th graders are highly engaged vs only one-third of high schoolers.
findings.application: Target engagement interventions especially for middle and high school

findings.title: Engagement Impact on Success
findings.summary: Engaged students are 2.5x more likely to get excellent grades and 4.5x more likely to be hopeful about the future.

findings.title: Attention Span Decline
findings.summary: Average attention span decreased from 12 seconds (2000) to 8 seconds (2013) - shorter than a goldfish.
findings.application: Quick rewards, visual feedback, and bite-sized achievements

findings.title: Causes of Reduced Attention
findings.summary: Constant stimulation, multitasking, and dopamine rewards from digital platforms train brains to seek constant novelty.
findings.application: Compete with digital distractions by using same engagement mechanisms for education

findings.title: Autonomy Increases Engagement
findings.summary: Freedom to make choices and take ownership leads to greater creativity, productivity, and satisfaction.
findings.application: Student choice in rewards, goals, and personalization

findings.title: Reward-Seeking Brain Development
findings.summary: Reward-seeking brain parts mature earlier than frontal cortex (self-control). Preteens are at particularly vulnerable point.
findings.application: Design rewards that support positive development rather than exploit vulnerabilities

findings.title: Loss Tolerance Through Play
findings.summary: Through play, children develop social skills including self-governance, joint decision making, and accepting when you lose.
findings.application: Competition features designed for positive experiences even when losing

findings.title: Social Development After School
findings.summary: After-school hours may be more valuable for social development and mental health than anything in school except recess.
findings.application: Social features that extend beyond classroom hours

findings.title: Overprotection Problem
findings.summary: Overprotection in real world and underprotection in virtual world are major reasons for increased anxiety in Gen Z.
findings.application: Balanced approach to competition and challenge with appropriate safeguards

findings.title: Technology as Supplement
findings.summary: EdTech yields greatest benefits when teachers receive proper training and use technology to enhance, not replace, instruction.
findings.application: Design for teacher empowerment, not teacher replacement

findings.title: Effective EdTech Uses
findings.summary: Most impactful when personalizing learning, delivering interactive content, facilitating collaboration, and offering real-time feedback.
findings.application: All four areas are core to Expanse's approach

statistics.description: Engaged students more likely to get excellent grades
Engaged students more likely to be hopeful about future
